programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman Empire crumbles, young Romulus Augustus flees the city and embarks on a perilous voyage to Britain to track down a legion of supporters.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: A Texas Ranger investigates a series of unexplained deaths in a town called Helena.

programme.title: Minotaur
programme.desc: When the villagers offer their brethren as a sacrifice to the Minotaur, Theo sets off on a harrowing quest to the labyrinth to kill the evil bull-god.

programme.title: Children Ruin Everything, Season: 4, Episode: 5
programme.desc: In order to find more time for themselves at night, Astrid and James attempt to implement a strict bedtime routine for the kids.

programme.title: Children Ruin Everything, Season: 4, Episode: 6
programme.desc: After feeling pushed out of Dawn’s pregnancy by her surrogate, Astrid, encouraged by James, begins to suspect her of something sinister.

programme.title: Whose Line is it Anyway?, Season: 9, Episode: 9
programme.desc: Games performed: Questions Only, Film and Theatre Styles, Old Job/New Job, Home Shopping, Quick Change, Party Quirks, Mission: Impossible, Greatest Hits

programme.title: Dark Tourist
programme.desc: [noun] • one who visits the scene of a violent crime or tragedy. A lonely man's obsession takes him to horrific murder scenes, but on this journey he is unable to control his rancid sexual impulses, and his grip on reality deteriorates into a violent despair.

programme.title: Accidental Family
programme.desc: A shy lonely genealogist finally discovers the perfect family and the love of her life… they just don’t know it yet! They mistakenly think she’s a long lost relative, and unfortunately he is engaged to the wrong girl who just wants his family fortune. As sparks start to fly, she must warn him of his deceptive fiance and find a way to tell him the truth about herself.

programme.title: ADDicted
programme.desc: Like most college kids, Drew’s life is full of chaos. His Adderall is his life line. When he gets suspended from football, his dependency to the drug increases. What will it take for Drew to find inner happiness without a pill bottle?

programme.title: Beatles: How the Beatles Changed the World
programme.desc: A fascinating story of the cultural, social, spiritual and musical revolution that was ignited by The Beatles, with revealing interviews and rarely-seen archival footage of the band.

programme.title: Pound Of Flesh
programme.desc: In China to donate his kidney to his dying niece, Deacon (VAN DAMME), an former black-ops agent, awakes the day before the operation to find he is the latest victim of organ theft. Stitched up and pissed-off, Deacon descends from his opulent hotel in search of his stolen kidney and carves a blood-soaked path through the darkest corners of the city - brothels, fight clubs, back-alley black markets, and elite billionaire estates.

programme.title: The White King
programme.desc: Djata is a care-free 12-year-old growing up in a brutal dictatorship shut off from the outside world. When the government imprisons his father, Peter, and Djata and his mother Hannah are labeled traitors, the boy will not rest until he sees his father again.

programme.title: Daylight's End
programme.desc: Years after a mysterious plague has turned most of humanity into blood-hungry creatures, a vengeful drifter takes up with a group of survivors in an abandoned police station.

programme.title: Alpha Code
programme.desc: After losing both his wife and his daughter in a series of mysterious disappearances, a man begins to see a strange symbol everywhere he goes. Waking up in the hospital and held captive by armed agents, he escapes and encounters a woman who seemingly holds knowledge of a larger conspiracy involving alien abductions and the creation of human hybrids.

programme.title: Triple Cross
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Eddie Chapman, a British bank robber, finds himself caught between the warring parties in WWII, the British and the Germans. Working as a spy for both sides, he tries to play each side against the other.

programme.title: Somewhere In Time
programme.desc: He Sacrificed Life In The Present…To Find Love In The Past. Somewhere In Time is the story of a young writer who sacrifices his life in the present to find happiness in the past, where true love awaits him. Young Richard Collier (Christopher Reeve) is approached by an elderly woman who gives him an antique gold watch and who pleads with him to return in time with her. Years later, Richard Collier is overwhelmed by a photograph of a beautiful young woman (Jane Seymour). Another picture of this woman in her later years reveals to him that she is the same woman who had given him the gold watch. Collier then becomes obsessed with returning to 1912 and the beautiful young woman who awaits him there.

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: Branded a coward for surrendering his New Mexico fort to the Confederates without firing a shot, a Union colonel leads a band of condemned prisoners on a suicide mission to recapture it.

programme.title: You Can't Win 'Em All
programme.desc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss’ gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey’s three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

programme.title: Porch Pirates
programme.desc: Three small-town detectives go head-to-head with a gang of porch pirates who snatch the mayor’s prized Beanie Baby and Christmas pickles in this fast-paced holiday comedy filled with twists and laughs.

programme.title: A Model Christmas
programme.desc: Cali, an up-and-coming model, sees that there is more to life than just work when she and her driver, Jack, are forced to seek shelter from the winter weather at Jack’s family home.

programme.title: 12 Dogs of Christmas II: Great Puppy Rescue
programme.desc: The kids of Doverville find themselves in a race against time and impossible odds to rescue a dog orphanage from an unscrupulous tycoon.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 2, Episode: 6
programme.desc: When a chef is accused of killing a prominent restaurant critic with poisonous mushrooms, it's up to Shawn and Gus to make sure the real killer gets his "just desserts." John Amos guest stars.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 2, Episode: 7
programme.desc: A group of genius teenagers from a school for gifted students claims one of their teachers is a murderer. After striking out with the police, their last hope is Shawn and Gus, who go undercover and soon discover the kids' imaginations might not be so wild after all.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 2, Episode: 8
programme.desc: A highly accomplished burglary ring is hitting Santa Barbara homes, all in the middle of the day, leaving no trace of how they gained access. Shawn and Gus want on the case, but Interim Chief Vick has an even more important job for them -- she needs them to find her a new nanny. A task they readily accept as a way into the burglary case.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 2, Episode: 9
programme.desc: When an accused murderer goes on the lam, Shawn and Gus play bounty hunter, racing "Midnight Run" style to bring him in before the cops and a real bounty hunter get him first. However, the chase gets complicated when Shawn realizes the guy they are bringing in is innocent. Guest starring Kevin Sorbo.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 2, Episode: 4
programme.desc: After Lassiter's car gets stolen from in front of the police station, Shawn solves the case in record time. But he soon realizes that, even with his considerable talents, nothing's ever that easy, and must then drag Gus away from his vacation to further investigate a case he's already solved.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 2, Episode: 5
programme.desc: Shawn and Gus' childhood bully, Jimmy Nickels, who hasn't grown since sixth grade and is now a jockey, comes back into their lives when he hires them to find out why his horses keep losing. But a simple horse whispering assignment turns deadly when a rival jockey dies on his horse in the middle of a race. Guest starring Howard Hesseman.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 2, Episode: 6
programme.desc: When a chef is accused of killing a prominent restaurant critic with poisonous mushrooms, it's up to Shawn and Gus to make sure the real killer gets his "just desserts." John Amos guest stars.

programme.title: S.W.A.T. (2003)
programme.desc: Superstars Samuel L. Jackson and Colin Farrell team up with a dazzling cast to form a crack S.W.A.T. team aiming to take down crime in this pulse-pounding, high-octane, action/adventure.

programme.title: Against All Odds (1984)
programme.desc: A dangerous love triangle develops when a shady nightclub owner hires an ex-football player to findhis runaway girlfriend.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: A young man is unwittingly caught up in a fight between a group trying to steal ancient Chinese artifacts and a group trying to preserve them. He has a unique style of fighting called "Drunken Boxing" which makes him a formidable opponent.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: An unlikely group of former '80s video game champions step up to save the world from an alien invasion in this visually spectacular action-adventure.

programme.title: Think Like A Man Too

programme.title: Man Of The House (2005)

programme.title: Seems Like Old Times

His ex-wife, Goldie Hawn, is a liberal lawyer married to the local district attorney. When Chase arrives at their home seeking shelter, she takes him in and their passions are rekindled.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: To pay for his daughter's surgery, a card dealer teams up with a co-worker to pull off a casino heist.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: A journalist, cameraman and war correspondent embark on a mission to find the No.1 war criminal in Bosnia.

programme.title: The Family

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: An art curator decides to seek revenge on his abusive boss by conning him into buying a fake Monet.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, a group of close-knit friends find themselves trapped in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a menacing, blood thirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, tensions mount as long-buried secrets are revealed. As the body count rises, the group must put their differences aside and fight for survival.

programme.title: Seed of Chucky
programme.desc: Everyone's favorite killer doll returns - as the Chucky legacy continues with the introduction of an all-new family member! This time around, Chucky (voiced again by Brad Dourif) and his homicidal honey, Tiffany, are brought back to life by their orphan offspring, Glen. Then, the outrageous action goes Hollywood, as Chucky and his bride take Tinseltown by storm, unleashing a wild new rampage of murderous mayhem!

programme.title: Seed of Chucky

This time around, Chucky (voiced again by Brad Dourif) and his homicidal honey, Tiffany, are brought back to life by their orphan offspring, Glen. Then, the outrageous action goes Hollywood, as Chucky and his bride take Tinseltown by storm, unleashing a wild new rampage of murderous mayhem!

programme.title: Mockingbird
programme.desc: Three individuals each receive an anonymous, unmarked video camera and a horrifc ultimatum to continue flming...or die. Experience the terror through the eyes of these unsuspecting victims, with a chain of found-footage events so real and absolutely dreadful, you'll have to watch it again to believe it.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: If you’re not on social media, do you even exist? The issue faced by introvert Jed, whose absence from the digital world leaves him socially marooned. When social media maven Tasha realises she can exploit her vision of cultivating a celebrity out of a nobody, she transforms Jed into a high-profile social butterfly. However, a chance encounter with his high-school crush forms a new dilemma!

programme.title: Redwood
programme.desc: Breakout film at Frightfest Festival and a must-watch for all horror fans! Josh and Beth visit a secluded national park for some quality time. Ignoring the advice of the Park Rangers, they venture off trail and come face to face with Redwood's legendary wildlife. A fresh spin to a well-worn mythology, creating an edge-of-your seat movie to shred your nerves and make you think twice about camping.

programme.title: Blood Harvest
programme.desc: Hysteria, secrets, blame and judgement, it's time for a blood harvest. In an idyllic 1873 American Protestant village times are harsh and the grass is always greener on the other side. As the village suffers, one woman prospers and there are grumblings that she may be in league with the devil. Blood and secrets are shed and the cost of survival is revealed in this descent into the supernatural.

programme.title: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: A nightmare befalls a group of friends on the Appalachian trail in this iconic franchise reboot from the original creator Alan. B. McElroy. While on a dream trip, a group finds themselves at the mercy of an urban legend - The Foundation. As a freak accident drives the group deeper into the mountains, they find themselves succumbing one by one in a gruesome game of survival.

programme.title: The Sinners
programme.desc: When a clique of seven students at a popular Catholic high school, led by the daughter of a local pastor, form a secret cult where each of them embody one of the deadly seven sins, their scandalous behaviour catches the attention of the local community. The group quickly realises that someone in their Christian town wants to teach the girls a deadly lesson as they start to go missing, one by one.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: The Claus Family
programme.desc: After discovering his grandfather is Santa Claus, Jules has to help him deliver his presents all around the world. But Jules' hatred for Christmas might make that more difficult than Santa thought.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina and Franklin are seemingly the perfect couple, but after five years of marriage, a huge fight at Thanksgiving leads them to divorce, set to be finalised on Christmas day. As they try to move on with their lives, will the festive spirit pull them back together? Starring Erica Ash (Scary Movie 5, Survivor's Remorse) and Eva Marcille (The Young and the Restless).

programme.title: Merry Good Enough
programme.desc: Lucy Raulie has always had a complicated relationship with her family, but when her mother disappears on Christmas Eve, the dysfunctional family hit a new all-time low. Aided by her reluctant siblings in an attempt to bring the family back together, the Raulie kids may get more than they bargained for when their eccentric father, George, also shows up to "help" in the search for their wayward mom. A razor-sharp and delightfully heartwarming festive comedy, packed with classic Christmas songs and a stand-out ensemble cast, including Joel Murray (Mad Men), Sawyer Spielberg (Masters of the Air), Susan Gallagher (Cobra Kai), Neil Casey (Ghostbusters, Avenue 5), Comfort Clinton (Billions, FBI), Sophie von Haselberg (Give Me Pity, Pose) and Raye Spielberg.

programme.title: Rare Exports: A Christmas Tale
programme.desc: Do you believe in Santa Claus? On the eve of Christmas a young boy sets out to discover the truth behind several strange goings on in his small isolated village. Why have all the reindeer been slaughtered? Who took all the hairdryers and radiators? And where have all the children gone? Seal the chimney. Lock the doors. Hide your children. This year the real Santa Claus is coming to town.

programme.title: O.H.M.S.
programme.desc: Hunted for a murder he did not commit, small-time crook Jimmy flees for England.

programme.title: Malta Story

programme.title: Nine Men
programme.desc: Sergeant Watson listened to the grumbles of his men, who had been going through a day's heavy training.

programme.title: Old Bill and Son
programme.desc: Bill has grumbled his way through WWI. Now it is WWII and, jealous of his son, he decides to enlist.

programme.title: THE CHRISTMAS EDITION.

programme.title: The Christmas Pact.

programme.title: THE CHRISTMAS EDITION.

programme.title: FIRST OF THE FEW, THE
programme.desc: An acclaimed aircraft designer works tirelessly to design an innovative new fighter plane

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: (1978) A-list action adventure with Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris. The heat is on for the Wild Geese as they parachute into a hostile African nation to rescue its imprisoned leader...

programme.title: The Quick And The Dead

programme.title: Web Of Lies

programme.desc: A DNA test helps Candace connect with her birth parents

programme.desc: (2018) Festive drama with Tatyana Ali. A lawyer returns to her home town after her sister's death, and discovers the will requires her to stay for 30 days over Christmas to inherit the family home.

programme.desc: (2015) Holiday romance with Julie Benz. An uptight woman agrees to play Mrs Claus at her family's department store, and finds herself becoming merrier working alongside a charming man playing Santa.

programme.title: Christmas Child
programme.desc: As Jack delves into the mysteries surrounding the nativity and its creator, he uncovers secrets from his past, reunites with the family he never knew.

programme.title: Christmas Magic
programme.desc: After a car accident, a woman awakens in Central Park with an angel, who gives her a chance to earn entrance to heaven. The film is a story of discovery and the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.desc: Sparks fly between a famous model and a farmer with a young daughter when she visits her childhood home. The town is in danger of losing their beloved Santaland festival, but miracles can happen with a little love, family, and faith.

programme.title: A Christmas Promise
programme.desc: Uptight city accountant Michael Thompson is hired to help a family save their stable before the bank shuts them down. Michael reluctantly agrees, but as he searches for ways to save a family's legacy, he finds something he never expected.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television. Aka R.I.A.

programme.title: Meet the Firm: Revenge in Rio
programme.desc: On the hunt for the Russian mobsters that murdered their best friend football hooligans turned career-criminals, Mike and Eddie, are led to Brazil where a major drug deal is set to take place under the cover of the World Cup. Looking to hijack the deal and gain the ultimate redemption, the pair become caught between international drug cartels, local thugs and corrupt police. AKA White Collar Holligan 3

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina and Franklin are seemingly the perfect couple, the toast of all their friends and married on Christmas Day five years ago, in a ceremony people still talk about. At Thanksgiving, they have a huge fight and trusts are broken -- they decide to divorce. Their divorce will be final on ChristmasDay.

programme.title: The Christmas Cure

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: After winning a $50,000 prize, a man decides to pay things forward by buying Christmas gifts for strangers under the pseudonym "Lucky the Elf."

Twenty years later, she is alone, fired, and broke. When she and a friend decide to relocate to LA to start anew, she becomes attracted to their bus driver.

programme.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Penelope Spheeris' The Decline Of Western Civilization is a riveting, unflinching and hard-core film which adeptly captures the spirit of a major cultural phenomenon.

programme.title: Elvira: Mistress of the Dark
programme.desc: When she learns that her wealthy aunt has just died, vamp Elvira rushes off to the reading of the will.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher

programme.title: Hopscotch [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: Honeymoon In Vegas

programme.title: The Miseducation of Cameron Post

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Five young people find themselves stranded in Moscow, fighting to survive in the wake of a devastating alien attack.

programme.title: The Engineer

programme.title: Tom Clancy's Without Remorse
programme.desc: An elite Navy SEAL (Michael B. Jordan) uncovers an international conspiracy while seeking justice for the murder of his pregnant wife in "Without Remorse," the explosive origin story of action hero John Clark – one of the most popular characters in author Tom Clancy’s Jack Ryan universe.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: Sabotage, an action thriller that follows one of the best assault teams on the planet, an elite special operations team of ten DEA agents.

programme.title: Burying Yasmeen
programme.desc: One man's odyssey to put a ring on his dead ex-wife.

programme.title: Things Like This
programme.desc: When two guys with the same name start falling in love it seems like everything has aligned for them to be together. But is fate ever exactly how you expect it to be?

programme.title: Standing Up for Sunny
programme.desc: An isolated guy with cerebral palsy is railroaded into helping an unassertive comedienne, and finds love and acceptance through stand up comedy.

programme.title: Senior Moment

With special ops on their case, the boys hide the loot down the Church's Holy Well... only for it to seep out into the town's water supply.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence...

programme.title: The Man with the Iron Heart
programme.desc: THE MAN WITH THE IRON HEART, is a story about one of the most dangerous figures in the Nazi regime, and the brave men and women of the Resistance, who sought to take him down.

programme.title: Meteors
programme.desc: As meteor strikes become a common occurrence on Earth, a secluded ranch becomes ground zero for a couple fighting to keep their land.

programme.title: The Midnight Meat Train
programme.desc: A New York photographer hunts down a serial killer who butchers his victims on subway trains. Starring Bradley Cooper, based on Clive Barker's short story.

programme.title: Amish Abduction

But things turn even more dire when her husband returns, seeking custody of their son, and is willing to kill to achieve his goal…

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, natural disasters, famine and war have ripped America apart, creating the police state of New America.

programme.title: Round the Decay

programme.title: The Complex: Lockdown
programme.desc: After being tasked with saving the life of a potential bio-weapons terrorist, two London scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time - and air - running out.

programme.title: Chimera Strain
programme.desc: A disturbed scientist freezes his children alive, while he races to cure their genetic disease.

programme.title: Battle for Skyark

programme.title: Middle of Nowhere
programme.desc: With her husband in prison, life seems bleak for Ruby, but a chance encounter puts her back on a journey towards a future she thought was lost.

programme.title: Lonely Hearts
programme.desc: In this thrilling crime drama, two homicide detectives track down Martha Beck and Raymond Martinez Fernandez, a murderous pair known as the "Lonely Hearts Killers." Starring Salma Hayek, John Travolta, James Gandolfini, Jared Leto and more.

programme.title: I Want You Back
programme.desc: Peter and Emma thought they were on the precipice of life’s biggest moments – marriage, kids, and houses in the suburbs – until their respective partners dumped them.

programme.title: Overboard

programme.title: Wedding Planning
programme.desc: On today’s episode, we get an exclusive invite to the planning behind the wedding of the decade. From pre-match nerves to Elton John’s florist - learn more about the planning of the most important day of Abbey’s life (and probably Pete’s as well). We also hear how Abbey feels how she has made a load of new friends since starting the podcast and why Peter is still struggling to show his face in the bakery after THAT famous incident. programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Brian Cox’s Guide To Being A True Scot
programme.desc: Brian Cox sets the record straight on what it really means to be Scottish. From authentic Scottish slang to the biggest misconceptions people, especially in America, still get wrong. With sharp wit and no-nonsense honesty, he dives into real Scottish slang and what it actually means, the stereotypes that need binning immediately, the cultural differences that confuse the rest of the world, and a cheeky look at some of America's more baffling takes on Scotland.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy - Beeban Kidron Interview
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob - Spider Man Quiz Showdown
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer’s Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump’s Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational - Football Debate
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: People Are Deep: True Crime
programme.desc: In this powerful episode of People Are Deep, we talk to Maureen Sullivan, a survivor of child abuse at the Magdalene Laundries in Ireland. Maureen courageously shares her harrowing experiences growing up in these infamous institutions, where countless women and girls were subjected to harsh conditions, forced labor, and systemic abuse. She opens up about the physical and emotional scars left behind, the struggle to find her voice, and the lasting impact the Magdalene Laundries had on her life. Maureen also discusses the importance of remembrance, justice, and raising awareness about this dark chapter of history. This episode is a moving testament to survival, resilience, and the ongoing fight to ensure such abuses are never forgotten or repeated.

programme.title: People Are Deep: True Crime
programme.desc: What happens when the people meant to uphold the law become the ones breaking it? In this gripping episode of People Are Deep, we sit down with Lee Davies, a former prison officer from the North of England who ended up behind bars himself. Lee opens up about how he slowly crossed the line: starting with bending the rules, then smuggling in phones and contraband, until eventually becoming deeply entangled in the criminal world he was supposed to guard against. Through raw, honest storytelling, Lee takes us inside the emotional and moral decay that comes with institutional corruption: the pressure, the rationalisations, the greed, and the point of no return. He describes the moment he was caught, the shock of being sentenced, and what it’s like to go from officer to inmate, living in the same environment he once controlled. Now determined to share his story to warn others, Lee reflects on what led him down the wrong path and the lessons he’s taken from hitting rock bottom. This episode is a rare look at the hidden vulnerabilities inside Britain’s prison system, and the thin line between power and temptation.

programme.title: People Are Deep: True Crime
programme.desc: What goes on in the mind of someone who’s been kidnapped - and what does it take to bring them home alive? In this gripping episode of People Are Deep, we speak to Dr. James R. Alvarez, a psychiatrist and expert in the psychology of hostage negotiation. He’s the only consultant ever used by both Scotland Yard and the NYPD Hostage Negotiation Teams, and has been at the center of some of the most sensitive, high-risk kidnappings in the world. Dr. Alvarez takes us deep into the world of kidnap-for-ransom cases, the psychological profiles of kidnappers, and the emotional toll on victims. He reveals the core tactics of successful negotiators, why ego can kill a negotiation, and the surprising mistakes law enforcement agencies often make. He also shares powerful case studies and explains how his background in psychiatry allows him to read between the lines - literally saving lives by understanding tone, silence, and fear. If you’ve ever wondered what it takes to talk someone off the edge or convince a captor to let someone go - this is a rare look into the mind behind the message.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: November 1943 to February 1944. In November, the US marines take the tiny Pacific atoll of Tarawa, but at a terrible cost. Back home, Japanese-Americans are permitted to form a special segregated infantry unit and begin to train for combat. As the war economy booms, ugly racial violence erupts in cities across the country. Overseas, in the mountains south of Rome, the allies try to fight their way around the edges of Monte Cassino, but are stopped cold. A series by Ken Burns. Part 5 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1944 to June 1944. American and British troops are pinned down at Anzio for months, while at Monte Cassino, the killing goes on and on. African-Americans, incensed at the segregation of the armed forces, put pressure on the military to make some changes. In May, allied soldiers at Cassino and Anzio resume their drive northward in Italy, liberating Rome on 4 June, but they let the retreating German army get away. A series by Ken Burns. Part 6 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: 6 June 1944: D-Day. In the early hours of 6 June 1944, the invasion of France begins. A million-and-a-half men take part. It is the bloodiest day in American history since the Civil War, though the Allies succeed in tearing a 45-mile gap in Hitler's vaunted Atlantic Wall. By day's end more than 150,000 men have landed on French soil, and more men, equipment and supplies are coming ashore every hour. A series by Ken Burns. Part 7 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: June 1944 to August 1944. American and British troops in Normandy are bogged down in the hedgerows, while in the Pacific, the marines fight their costliest battle to date on the island of Saipan. Back home, dreaded telegrams from the War Department begin arriving at a rate inconceivable just one year earlier. But by mid-August, the Germans are in full retreat out of France, and on 25 August, after four years of Nazi occupation, Paris is liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 8 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In September of 1944, with their troops in Europe stalled on the German border having outrun their supply lines, Allied commanders gamble on a risky plan to drop thousands of airborne troops behind enemy lines in Holland. When the mission ends in disaster, it becomes painfully clear that the war in Europe will not end before winter. In the Pacific, on the island of Peleliu, the marines fight one of the most brutal campaigns of the war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 9 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In the late autumn of 1944 American soldiers suffer terrible losses when they are ordered into the forbidding and fiercely defended terrain of the H�rtgen Forest and the Vosges Mountains. In the Central Pacific, to the delight of audiences back home, General MacArthur returns to the island of Leyte. But months of bloody fighting lie ahead before the Philippine Islands, and the people imprisoned on them, can be liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 10 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Winter 1944 to 1945. The Allies are unprepared for Hitler's counterattack in the Ardennes Forest of Belgium and Luxembourg. It is the biggest battle of the war on the Western Front, fought during the coldest winter in memory. By the time the Battle of the Bulge is over, Hitler's enormous gamble has ended in disaster and the Russians are approaching Berlin. Meanwhile, in the Santo Tomas Camp in the Philippines, thousands of internees await liberation. A series by Ken Burns. Part 11 of 14.

programme.title: Children of the Sun

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Spain: The Atlantic North
programme.desc: From the reedy areas in the Basque Country, via the fantastic world of the Cantabrian mountain range, to Galicia with its spectacular coasts: This is the North Spanish wilderness, which offers unheard of diversity and reveals a hitherto completely unknown side of Spain. In the wetlands during the rutting season, red deer carry out their bitter power struggles until the water around them appears to blister and boil. The Cantabrian mountain range is habitat for around 140 Cantabrian brown bears – Western Europe’s greatest bear population. The females wander from place to place in search of food. Adult male bears and steep mountain slopes are a permanent danger for the youngsters. Iridescent blue throats, defending their territorial borders against rivals, appear to observe them. Above the timberline is the Kingdom of the Cantabrian chamois. They share their habitat with the colourful wallcreeper - an extremely rare bird of the tall mountain region. The Asturian fire salamander is the only one of its kind with a complete yellow hue - he hunts his prey on the banks of the countless streams that flow into the Atlantic, which is inhabited by giants; from sperm whales to basking sharks, the world’s second largest fish. The rugged north has shaped the identity of its inhabitants. The film accompanies a mountain farmer in the Picos de Europa National Park, who still operates traditional livestock farming and a goose barnacle collector on the Costa da Morte, who quite possibly has the world’s most dangerous job. Common to both is the fact that neither of them would exchange their homeland for life in the city.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Jae-hyung episode 222
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - J_ust episode 223
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - YESEO episode 224
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show

programme.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa; linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

programme.desc: Scientists are developing more powerful magnets to enable clean energy sources like fusion; China's dominance of the supply chain for rare earth magnets threatens their global availability.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Chinese companies dominate the EV battery supply chain and are expanding rapidly outside their home market. Meanwhile, competitors are looking to new chemistries to leapfrog the leading tech.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Humanoid robots that use AI are going mainstream, but they're far from proven; with billions of dollars invested, can they deliver real-world value, or will they fall short of the hype?

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices; global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex. From mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Scientists are developing more powerful magnets to enable clean energy sources like fusion; China's dominance of the supply chain for rare earth magnets threatens their global availability.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: AI's rapid growth is pushing global energy demand skyward, forcing electrical grids to expand and modernize. Now, companies from China to Nigeria are investing in new tech to power the future.

programme.title: Bloomberg Originals
programme.desc: "Bloomberg Originals" offers bold takes for curious minds on today's biggest topics; hosted by experts covering stories you haven't seen and viewpoints you haven't heard, you'll discover cinematic, data-led shows that investigate the intersection of business and culture; exploring every angle of climate change, technology, finance, sports and beyond, "Bloomberg Originals" is business as you've never seen it.

programme.title: Swarms: The Intelligence of the Masses
programme.desc: Swarms of animals move in perfect sync without a leader, inspiring scientists and engineers to create autonomous robot swarms for missions like surgery or rescue. This documentary also explores human group behavior, asking if we can be smarter together. Discover the hidden intelligence of swarms and what it reveals about us.

programme.title: Fear Trip
programme.desc: In this thrilling first episode, Géraud ventures into the Amazon to find the Huaorani. He hunts crocodiles barehanded, steals honey from angry bees, joins shaman rituals, and drinks ayahuasca. Facing hornets and deadly coral snakes, his survival instincts are pushed to the limit in this raw, life-threatening journey.

programme.title: The Rising of China Arctic
programme.desc: As Arctic ice melts, China—calling itself a “near-Arctic state”—pushes into the region with major investments in gas, shipping, and the “Polar Silk Road.” While nations like Norway and the U.S. grow cautious, this film explores whether China’s Arctic ambitions are purely economic—or something more strategic.

programme.title: Stolen Blood Antiquities
programme.desc: After the looting of sites in Syria, Iraq, and Libya, stolen antiquities are flooding global markets—some funding terror groups like ISIS. This gripping documentary follows a year-long investigation into the illegal trade, revealing how history is trafficked and whether these relics can be recovered before they're lost forever.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm: More than Fairy Tales
programme.desc: This docudrama reveals how the Brothers Grimm used folk tales to inspire German unity under foreign rule. Blending dramatized scenes with their writings, it explores their deep bond, the origins of beloved fairy tales, and the political mission behind their storytelling legacy.

programme.title: Changing the Face of Diamonds
programme.desc: Follow online diamond sellers Chloé Guillon and David Sussman from Bombay to Antwerp as they uncover how diamonds are made, priced, and sold today. Why are they getting cheaper? And is their allure fading? A revealing look into the global gem trade—from cutting floors to online storefronts.

programme.title: Gambling on Extinction
programme.desc: From Africa to Asia, this gripping doc exposes the billion-dollar trade in ivory, rhino horn, and tiger parts. Poachers aren't the only threat—global cartels, investors, and corruption drive species toward extinction. A bold look at the dark link between wildlife crime and global greed.
